DecisiveCmdDie00.description: Leader. Give the targeted ally a command die on their next test. 07-24w: replaced a name-gated useItem hook (iron rule 2b). The die is 1d(4 + 2 * @owned) where @owned counts how many of the three Command upgrades you have — d4 / d6 / d8 / d10 — because nothing in roll data exposes an owned-talent count, so a literal formula could not express the scaling. NOTE the card's 'within 20 ft' is still NOT enforced: no distance check existed before this conversion either, and adding one is a behaviour change tied to the open Authority question (audit 9m q13). 07-24x (Ben's q13 ruling to BUILD it): the card's 'within 20 ft' is now ENFORCED, vetoed pre-cost, and `doubleIfOwns: Authority` doubles BOTH the range (40 ft) and the ally count (2) — which is exactly what Authority's card says.

DecisiveAuthort0.description: Leader UPGRADE RIDER — Authority. 07-24x: Ben ruled BUILD IT, so this is no longer a reminder for unenforced text — `doubleIfOwns: Authority` on the rule above actually doubles the range and the target count. The note stays so the player is told what changed and knows to target two allies.
